integrity: The equal intrinsic volumes and the width-law separation are proved analytically from support-function curvature identities and exact sphere moments. The included standard-library program checks only the explicit polynomial arithmetic and is not a substitute for the proof.
limitations: The construction separates the random-width laws only. It does not prove different brightness laws for the same smooth pair, and the positive-curvature epsilon threshold is not optimized numerically. A poorly indexed earlier smooth construction remains a residual originality risk.
title: Smooth equal-intrinsic-volume bodies with distinct random-width laws
